title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Kara Reed"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
count(mallards, month)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  group_by(season, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.8,
    scale = 3,
    rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
